title: 横移组合从容收尾
description: 孔版印刷在低位横移的最后一步中融合换重心、踏点和短伸手。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration shows a fictional adult completing a low horizontal traverse with a calm combination of weight transfer, precise shoe placement, and a short hand reach. Both feet remain on clearly drawn positive footholds, one hand stays on a broad violet jug, and the other approaches a nearby final rounded hold. The torso stays close to a gently slabby wall, with thick continuous crash mats filling the foreground and the landing area empty. Use a wide three-quarter composition showing the entire opaque-clothed adult, layered cobalt, lilac, and peach print textures, and believable contacts. The scene is peaceful and original. No captions, brands, jumping, dangerous height, or portrait framing.
